_meta.why_this_file: data/layouts.json is regenerated wholesale by tools/layouts.py, and mmJaxis's entry there came from tools/ctor_layouts.py, which can see the WIDTH of every store a constructor makes but not whether the dword it writes is an integer or a float. Every one of the seven mmJaxis functions reads or writes these same offsets with x87 instructions, which settles it. The offsets and the total size are UNCHANGED - 0x1C, six dwords and a pair the constructor never touches - so this is a retyping, not a new layout. Re-merge with tools/merge_layouts.py --write if layouts.json is ever regenerated.

_meta.note_on_names: 0x10/0x14 were a single `u8 field_10[8]` blob because no constructor writes them. ResetCapture writes each half as its own dword and Capture compares each half with fcom, so they are two f32 and not an eight-byte anything. The pair is left uninitialised by the constructor on purpose - see Trap 12.
